regions.name: flow_lift_wake
regions.why: The lift-induced wake / TE vorticity sheet is a downstream transport feature whose corridor is currently 0.386% covered. A level-3 box (0.03125 m = half the declared 0.0623 m max span) placed exactly on the requirement bounds refines the corridor to full coverage at one level below the level-4 surface mesh, matching the existing level-3 outer distance band so no internal level step is created.

regions.name: flow_tip_left
regions.why: Left tip-vortex corridor is only 0.18% covered and its declared span (0.04981 m) is the tightest of the three; level 3 gives 0.03125 m, a factor 1.6 below the requirement, and overlaps the wake box so the union is one equal-level block along the vortex path (no transition defect inside the corridor).

regions.name: flow_tip_right
regions.why: Mirror tip-vortex corridor with identical 0.04981 m span requirement; level 3 = 0.03125 m meets it. Spanwise symmetry is preserved exactly (Y bounds mirrored about 0) so the two rolled-up vortices are resolved with equal nominal cell size, which matters because at AR~2 the two vortices interact.

regions.name: repair_2
regions.why: local native FV quality failure; repair before layer optimisation

advisor.hypothesis: The failure is a LAYER-EXTRUSION/TRANSITION defect localised on the trailing-edge strip, not under-resolution. Native log: only 51275/75174 faces (68.2%) extruded, both outer passes identical, \"Reducing layer thickness at 0 nodes\", 0 retained truncation lines, 4 isolated points stopped => all-or-nothing NON-EXTRUSION with no thickness compression, so non-extruded columns sit beside full-height 8-layer columns and shear into the 194 zero/negative-volume cells, aspect 2.8e95, 1079 misoriented pyramids and skew 649. Localisation: the TE strip X 0.90-1.05 has solid normal half-thickness p50 = 0.00735 m (p5 0.00084) while the requested stack is 0.01829 m = 2.5x that; and 50.8-54.3% of adjacent edges there are above layer feature_angle=60 with dihedral p50 = p95 = 90 deg. So the TE crease triggers corner/edge-disabled extrusion and the stack cannot fit the local wall-normal room. The X 0.6-0.9 strip is thinner (p50 0.029 m, 54% edges >60 deg, 0-layer fraction 0.198) and is a secondary loss site. Smooth regions (feature_0) already hold 54.4% full 8 layers, so the stack itself is fine where there is room. Counterevidence respected: fluid_gap_metres is null and finite outward-ray fraction is 0.0 everywhere, so rays prove nothing about gaps; I therefore do NOT treat the region as gap-free, but I also do not invent a gap. The medial distance, not the solid half-thickness, is the shrinker's limiting quantity, so I lower max_thickness_to_medial_ratio so the limiter acts (halving toward min_thickness) instead of the column inverting. Also, thickness reduction at 0 nodes proves the limiter never engaged - it was configured too permissively for the real medial distance. Mechanism fix = (a) make the limiter engage softly, (b) suppress extrusion at the 90 deg TE/tip creases by lowering layer feature_angle below 60, (c) trim the stack so 5+ layers survive on >=90% of area. I keep first height 0.001108680899312848 m (y+~50 surrogate; no sane measured flow, so wall_height is not eligible) and do NOT add flow boxes: all three corridors already pass natively (occupancy 1.0, p95 span 0.0317 m vs 0.0623/0.0498 m) at 1.235M of a 2M gate.
advisor.expected_change: Native extrusion fraction 68.2% -> target >90% of 75174 body faces; zero/negative-volume cells 194 -> 0; max_aspect 2.8e95 -> <1000; wrong-oriented face pyramids 1079 -> 0; skew 649 -> <4; non-ortho 179.8 -> <70; body area with >=5 layers 0.669 -> >=0.90; expected cells ~1.20-1.25M (at or below the 1.235M baseline, well under the 2M gate). Uncertainty: if TE creases still disable extrusion, coverage will plateau and the remaining lever is slip_feature_angle/n_buffer_cells_no_extrude, which I have left at baseline to avoid a blind double change.
alternatives: If coverage still plateaus with 8 layers, keep n_surface_layers=8 and instead raise max_thickness_to_medial_ratio and n_smooth_thickness (softer limiter, more smoothing) rather than cutting layers.

If the 90 deg TE creases keep disabling extrusion, raise n_buffer_cells_no_extrude to 1-2 (partial NOEXTRUDE spreading) or drop slip_feature_angle to 20 (extrude over slipping walls) - not done here to avoid two simultaneous crease changes.

If quality persists only at the TE box, add one local_refine level=5 box on X 0.90-1.05, |Y|<=0.10, Z <=0.15 (legal, one level above surface level 4, small area); rejected for now because cells share the 2M gate and the failure is extrusion, not resolution.

No restore is possible: none of plan:7932afe0cebdb8ce / f62967be11e235b5 / 2d715090c42f3a28 / 3dca9c5fca758495 is eligible_for_restore, and all four show the same 6 native failures, so the anchor hypothesis is untested.
counterevidence: All four prior rounds (round 0-3) share the identical 6 native failures and layer coverage 0.673-0.674, so no measured valid anchor exists; the layer mechanism has never been changed, only repair_* boxes added - those three boxes addressed the SAME sites and failed, so I add no more boxes.

feature_0 level-6 box overlaps the TE strip and imposes a level-4 to level-6 jump (two levels > n_cells_between_levels=3 buffer); it is a plausible contributor to the 1783 concave faces / 1470 concave cells, but removing it would coarsen a genuine sampled geometry feature without flow evidence, so I leave it and instead damp layer-driven distortion via the other settings.
n_grow is deliberately NOT increased: it propagates non-extrusion and would LOWER coverage below 0.90 rather than fill uncovered faces.
No flow probe and no actual y+, so no wall_height and no assertion of physical/RANS accuracy; this is a mesh-mechanism repair only.
Whole-body coverage is area-weighted; a local success at the TE box cannot by itself certify the 90% gate.

actions.why: Shift the layer driver from all-or-nothing non-extrusion to soft thickness limiting: the mover reduced thickness at 0 nodes because max_thickness_to_medial_ratio=0.3 was never reached against the real medial field, so columns beside non-extruded faces inverted. Trimming the installed stack to 6 layers (~0.0123 m) at unchanged first height keeps p50 y+ behaviour while fitting under the TE-strip p50 solid half-thickness of 0.00735 m and under the medial room; lowering layer feature_angle to 45 suppresses extrusion at the ~90 deg (p50=p95=90) TE/tip creases where 50.8-54.3% of edges already exceed 60; the medial-ratio and smoothing changes make the limiter act before inversion. n_grow stays 0 because it propagates NON-EXTRUSION and would reduce coverage.

Cleaner surface snapping reduces the normal misalignment that feeds the medial-axis mover's collision at the TE strip: the same box holds 222 meshQualityFaces, 192 wrong-oriented faces and 159 low-vol-ratio faces at median wall distance 0.0273 m with measured local feature 0.0507 m. More feature-snap iterations and stronger patch/tolerance smoothing before the layer pass is the causal counterpart to the layer change, not a second unrelated intervention.
